title: Unmarked finite-free lift across a nilpotent quotient
statement: theorem exists_unmarked_finiteFree_lift_of_nilpotent {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (hnil : ∃ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N ∧ I ^ N = 0) (hunits : ∀ x : I, IsUnit (1 + (x : R))) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I))] (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I))) (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶ @Functor.mapHomotopyCategory _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).left_adjoint_additive (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh) [L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (.up ℤ))] (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) (hK : IsPseudoCoherent K) (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I)) ℤ) (b : ℤ) (hFbound : F.IsStrictlyLE b) (hFterms : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free (R ⧸ I) (F.X i) ∧ Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) (F.X i)) (α : L.obj K ≅ Q.obj F) : ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ) (β : Q.obj P ≅ K) (θ : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P ≅ F), P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free R (P.X i) ∧ Module.Finite R (P.X i))

source.place: Tags 0H76, 0BCB and 0BCA, decomposition of the marked lift proof

proof.text: Take E = Classical.choose hK with its bound c, finite free terms and isomorphism gamma : Q(E) ≅ K. Its terms are projective. Apply the proved ordinary-module helper CochainComplex.projective_reduction_comparison from the nilpotent projective complex lifting module. It identifies L(Q(E)) with Q(E tensor R/I), allowing independent ring/module and derived localization universes. Compose its inverse with L(gamma) and alpha to obtain the derived reduction isomorphism required by the stably-free lifting theorem.

Finite free quotient terms are finite stably free. Apply DerivedCategory.exists_stablyFree_lift_mod_ideal (Stacks 0BCB) to K, hK and the prescribed F, using the preceding derived isomorphism. Obtain P, beta, theta, finite stably free terms, and freeness of P.X i from freeness of F.X i.

For i > b, F.X i is zero. Evaluate theta to see that the scalar extension of P.X i is zero. The zero endomorphism of its scalar extension is therefore surjective. Since P.X i is finite, apply ModuleCat.surjective_of_extendScalars_mod_ideal to the zero endomorphism of P.X i. Its surjectivity makes P.X i a subsingleton, hence a zero object. The criterion P.isStrictlyLE_iff gives the exact bound b. Package P, beta, theta, this bound and the finite free term properties. Only the unit hypothesis is needed for this final Nakayama argument; the nilpotence hypothesis remains unchanged.

proof_origin.note: Specialization of the existing proved lifting theorem, using the proved projective reduction comparison helper for independent universes. All glue and the exact-bound argument are proved in Lean; no new statements or holes.
